item.title: Homebhoys – Room 1 on 1 – Paul Quigley (HomeBhoys)
item.description: 10:49 PM Dec 10, 2025: Welcone back to another episode of Room 1 on 1 from the Homebhoys. On this one, Scott is joined by Jason an special guest Paul Quigley from the Celtic Fans Collective, after early Decembers meeting at Celtic Park, between Celtic and Police Scotland, to discuss the Fairhurst report of the incident at the Celtic Supporters Association in March. We go through the events that led to this meeting and Paul gives us a run down of events that happened on the night itself Enjoy!
